card.name: Prescriber and medical supervision wording
card.fires_on: The end of words about who directs care, such as the 'ber' in prescriber, and 'supervised' or 'supervision' after 'medically' or 'medical'. It also fires on 'professional' after 'healthcare'.

modes.label: Prescriber
modes.description: The closing piece of 'prescriber' when the text refers to the clinician's decision or choice.
modes.example: first test (a screening test) is obtained by the prescri<<ber>> when the decision is made to pursue therapy

modes.label: Medical supervision
modes.description: 'supervised' or 'supervision' right after 'medically' or 'medical', describing care under a clinician.
modes.example: stabilization followed by a period of medically<< supervised>> withdrawal, titrate the patient to a

modes.label: Healthcare professional
modes.description: 'professional' after 'healthcare' when naming the person guiding therapy.
modes.example: under the guidance of a healthcare<< professional>> skilled in the use of insulin and supported

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like physician or medicine coming next, so the clinician term is already complete.
card.plain: It lights up on words that name the clinician in charge, like prescriber or medically supervised.
